items.title: The Almost Matching Socks

items.title: The Drawing That Grew

items.title: The Spare Part

items.title: The Quietest Part of the Walk
items.passage: Priya and Raj went on a garden walk with their class and teacher. Everyone had a card asking them to find five different sounds. At first, Raj wrote only birds, because their singing was easy to hear. Priya wrote footsteps and leaves after listening near the group.
